effects.title: 形状元素爆发 (Shape Elements burst)

effects.title: 重拍排版 Stomp (#4, TypoKing 1.34万份; B站动态歌词排版 898万)
effects.how: one word per beat slams full-frame, sizes alternate, every third beat inverts the frame; a 2-frame jolt on each hit. words: 1–12 (a list, "a|b|c", or just text → split into words). Long words wrap to two lines. With narration timestamps each word lands the moment it is spoken (like lyric typography).

effects.title: 标注引线 (Callout title)
effects.how: a dot pops on the subject, the leader line draws out, the label slides along it. image | video (+focus) as the ground; one point (x, y, text, sub) or points: [{x, y, text, sub}, …] up to 4. Labels turn left when the point is on the right third, and drop below when it is near the top.
effects.label: #18 引线标注 · Line Callout

effects.title: 数字滚轮 (Odometer / number wheel)
effects.how: each digit column spins down to its value, staggered. value: 46479 | "46,479" | -3.5 | "97.5" | 1.2e9 (numbers get thousands separators; zh:true → 万/亿).
effects.label: #20 数字滚动 · Counter

effects.title: 拼贴剪纸 (#21, Fakeplastictree Collage 203.5万)

effects.title: 描边书写 → 填色 (Trim Paths on text / 手写签名)

effects.title: 文字匹配剪辑 Text Match Cut (#23, Envato Elements 标题热门第1/2)
effects.how: the word holds its exact place while everything around it hard-cuts — background, colour field and typeface change every few frames. Each cut is a designed pair (ground + type treatment), so the word always reads. images: 0…N (all are cycled).
effects.ref: Envato Elements 标题热门第1、2名
effects.label: #23 文字匹配剪辑 · Text Match Cut

effects.title: 乱码解码 (Decoder / Scramble)
effects.how: every slot is a reel of random glyphs that steps (not slides) onto its real character, slots settling left→right. Pure transforms with a steps() ease, so it seeks in any order.
effects.label: 乱码解码 · Decoder

effects.title: 字距收拢 (Tracking In)
effects.how: glyphs start spread wide and drift together while sharpening — done with transforms (x offset ∝ distance from the centre of its own line), so it never snaps to whole pixels like letter-spacing would.
effects.label: 字距收拢 · Tracking In

effects.title: 逐字三维翻转 (3D Flip per character)
